- The app has an icon of its own, drawn from the same sparkline as the face.
- The desktop window opens at 0.7 of the face's size, so it takes a corner of the screen instead of the middle of it.
- The gear and VR marks in the face's corners are large enough to aim at.
- The settings window lists the desktop and VR settings last, after the ones both frontends share.

Installing, updating and what has been tested: [README](https://github.com/p-kitty/vr-cgm-overlay#download-for-windows).
